In this video, we uncover the real story of Operation Thunderbolt (1976) the high-risk Israeli rescue mission that stunned the world. After Air France Flight 139 was seized and flown to Entebbe, Uganda, with 53 prisoners and $5 million demanded in exchange for hostages, Israel planned a daring 4,000-km night operation. Commandos stormed the airport, rescued most of the captives, and changed the course of modern hostage-rescue strategy forever.
This mission didn’t just save lives, it reshaped global security and special operations planning, boosted Israel’s international standing, and sparked intense debate at the United Nations. Known today as Operation Yonatan, it remains one of the boldest rescue missions in history.
